title: Falling Bars
constraintsSummary: Time limit: 2 sec; Memory limit: 1024 MiB; Constraints: 1 \leq H, W \leq 2 \times 10^5; 1 \leq N \leq 2 \times 10^5; 1 \leq R_i \leq H; 1 \leq C_i \leq W; 1 \leq L_i \leq W - C_i + 1; In the initial state, there is no cell occupied by two different bars.; All input values are integers.
